hero.headline: Featured Projects
hero.subheadline: Real projects, real results. Here's how I've helped businesses grow through technology.

projects.title: UniSell Enterprise - Digital Commerce OS
projects.solution: A full-stack digital commerce platform that turns any software house into a global digital product business. Sell Code, SaaS, and Courses from one branded platform with built-in DRM and Licensing.

case_study.overview: UniSell Enterprise is a hybrid digital marketplace engine. It allows creators to sell mixed assets (Source Code, SaaS Subscriptions, Video Courses) on a single platform. It includes a White-Label Engine to resell the platform itself to other agencies.

challenge.title: The Problem
challenge.description: Creators struggle to sell mixed digital assets. Selling code on CodeCanyon, courses on Udemy, and SaaS on Stripe requires managing 3 different dashboards, paying high fees (30%), and dealing with piracy.
pain_points: Fragmented sales channels for Code, Courses, and SaaS
High commissions (30-50%) on third-party marketplaces
Digital piracy due to lack of built-in licensing/DRM
Complexity of handling global taxes and multi-currency payments

solution.title: The Solution
solution.description: Built an All-in-One Digital Commerce OS with unified cart, license server, and white-label capabilities.
key_features: Unified Storefront: Sell Files, SaaS, and Courses in one cart
Smart Licensing: Built-in License Server validates software activation
White-Label Engine: Clone the platform for clients in minutes
Global Payments: Multi-currency support (Stripe, PayPal, Crypto, Local Wallets)
LMS Module: Integrated video course player with certificates

results.title: The Impact
results.description: Empowered creators to own their platform and revenue.

testimonial.text: UniSell isn't just a store; it's an operating system for our digital business. We moved our courses, templates, and SaaS tools to one platform and increased our margins by 30% by cutting out the middlemen.
testimonial.author: Khateeb Ur Rehman

projects.title: Edu NexaLearn - Multi-Tenant SaaS LMS
projects.solution: A cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS platform that allows franchises to launch their own branded academies. Features microservices architecture, 99.99% uptime, and automated WhatsApp integration.

case_study.overview: Edu NexaLearn transforms a static, manual education business into a dynamic SaaS powerhouse. It enables the client to franchise their curriculum to hundreds of partners, each with their own isolated, branded platform running on a shared, scalable infrastructure.

challenge.title: The Problem
challenge.description: The client was stuck with a manual system dependent on WhatsApp groups, limiting growth. High traffic caused server crashes, and launching new branches required expensive manual setup.
pain_points: System crashes at 1M+ concurrent requests due to monolithic architecture
Manual invoicing and student communication via WhatsApp was unscalable
Inability to launch white-label franchises without code duplication
Lack of real-time analytics for multi-branch operations

solution.title: The Solution
solution.description: Architected a Microservices-based SaaS platform using Kubernetes for auto-scaling and a Multi-Tenant database strategy for data isolation.
key_features: Multi-Tenancy: Single codebase powering unlimited isolated franchise academies
Microservices Core: Decoupled services (Auth, Payment, Content) for resilience
WhatsApp Automation: Bot integration for instant invoices and class links
Shariah-Compliant Finance: Revenue model based on service fees, not interest
Gamified Learning: XP and Leaderboards to boost student retention

results.title: The Impact
results.description: Enabled the client to pivot from a local institute to a global SaaS provider.

metrics.label: Uptime
metrics.description: Achieved via K8s auto-scaling and redundancy

metrics.label: Scale
metrics.description: Concurrent requests handled during load testing

testimonial.text: NexaLearn isn't just an LMS; it's a business-in-a-box. We went from managing students on Excel to running a global franchise network. The automated WhatsApp notifications alone saved us hiring 5 support staff.
testimonial.author: CEO

projects.title: DigiMarket Enterprise - Digital Economy OS
projects.solution: A white-label digital marketplace infrastructure allowing governments and agencies to launch branded platforms for SaaS, APIs, and digital assets. Features global tax automation and DRM piracy protection.

case_study.overview: DigiMarket is not just a marketplace—it is a complete digital economy operating system. It enables the rapid deployment of white-label marketplaces where creators can sell SaaS, APIs, and courses with built-in global compliance.

challenge.title: The Problem
challenge.description: Launching a global digital marketplace is complex due to multi-country tax laws (VAT/GST), high piracy rates for digital goods, and the difficulty of handling split payments between platforms and sellers.
pain_points: Complex global tax compliance (VAT, GST, Sales Tax) for 100+ countries
Digital piracy rampant without strong DRM protection
Scalability issues when handling millions of concurrent downloads
Difficulty in automating affiliate commissions and payouts

solution.title: The Solution
solution.description: Built a multi-tenant, white-label infrastructure that handles the heavy lifting of global commerce, allowing clients to focus on growth.
key_features: White-Label Engine: Deploy branded marketplaces in minutes with tenant isolation
Global Tax Engine: Auto-calculation and remittance of taxes acting as Merchant of Record
Smart DRM: Encrypted delivery for PDFs, Videos, and Software to prevent piracy
Unified Wallet: Multi-currency payouts via Crypto, PayPal, and Bank Transfer
API Monetization: Built-in metering and billing for selling API access

results.title: The Impact
results.description: Enabled the creation of a secure, scalable digital economy ecosystem.

metrics.label: Uptime
metrics.description: High availability during peak traffic events

metrics.label: Piracy Breaches
metrics.description: Zero confirmed leaks due to DRM encryption

metrics.label: Deployment Time
metrics.description: Time to launch a new white-label marketplace

testimonial.text: DigiMarket allowed us to launch our national digital asset platform in weeks instead of years. The automated tax compliance alone saved us millions in legal fees. It's truly an operating system for the digital age.
testimonial.author: Sarah Jenkins

projects.title: EduVerse - AI-Powered LMS
projects.solution: A next-generation Learning Management System that uses AI to create adaptive learning paths and features live, interactive classrooms with real-time code collaboration.

case_study.overview: EduVerse solves the problem of passive learning by introducing AI-driven adaptive curriculums and live, interactive classrooms where instructors can collaborate on code and whiteboards in real-time.

challenge.title: The Problem
challenge.description: Traditional LMS platforms are static and boring, leading to course completion rates below 10%. Students lack real-time feedback and personalized attention.
pain_points: Passive video watching leads to low engagement
One-size-fits-all curriculum doesn't match student pace
Lack of real-time collaboration tools for coding/design
Instructors overwhelmed by grading manual assignments

solution.title: The Solution
solution.description: Built an 'Active Learning' platform with AI tutors, adaptive learning paths, and WebRTC-based live classrooms.
key_features: AI Personal Tutor: 24/7 chat bot that explains concepts and generates quizzes
Adaptive Curriculum: Knowledge graph that unlocks lessons based on mastery
Live Smart Classroom: HD Video + Real-time Code Editor + Whiteboard
Gamified Dashboard: Streaks, badges, and leaderboards to boost motivation
Auto-Grader: AI analysis of code submissions for instant feedback

results.title: The Impact
results.description: Transformed the learning experience, significantly boosting completion rates.

testimonial.text: EduVerse is lightyears ahead of Moodle. The ability to jump into a student's code editor during a live class has changed how we teach programming. The AI tutor also saves us hours of answering basic questions.
testimonial.author: Dr. Alan Grant

projects.title: Vitalis - Intelligent Healthcare Ecosystem
projects.solution: A unified SaaS platform bridging telemedicine, EMR, and AI-diagnostics. Reduced administrative burden by 40% and improved patient follow-up adherence by 60% through smart automation.

case_study.overview: Vitalis modernizes healthcare delivery by integrating Telemedicine, Electronic Medical Records (EMR), and AI-Assisted Diagnostics into a single, secure ecosystem. It solves the problem of fragmented patient data and inefficient scheduling.

challenge.title: The Problem
challenge.description: Doctors were struggling with disconnected systems for billing, appointments, and labs, leading to medical errors and lost history. Manual phone booking caused 30% patient no-show rates.
pain_points: Fragmented patient data across paper records and legacy software
High no-show rates due to lack of automated reminders
Limited access to specialists for remote patients
Diagnostic delays due to manual symptom analysis

solution.title: The Solution
solution.description: Built a secure, HIPAA-compliant SaaS platform with real-time video consultations, smart scheduling, and AI-powered triage.
key_features: Unified EMR: Centralized patient history, prescriptions, and lab reports
Smart Scheduling Engine: Automated SMS/WhatsApp reminders to reduce no-shows
HD Telemedicine Suite: Secure browser-based video calls with screen sharing
AI-Assisted Triage: Pre-screening bot to highlight potential red flags
Digital Prescriptions: One-click PDF generation with drug interaction warnings

results.title: The Impact
results.description: The platform significantly improved operational efficiency and patient access to care.

metrics.label: No-Show Rate
metrics.description: Decrease in missed appointments via smart reminders

testimonial.text: Vitalis has transformed how we manage our clinic. The ability to see a patient's entire history while on a video call is a game-changer. The AI triage helps us prioritize critical cases effectively.
testimonial.author: Dr. Sarah Ahmed

projects.title: AID²E - Islamic Digital Ecosystem
projects.solution: Enterprise-scale digital operating system for Masjids, Madrasas, and Islamic institutions with transparent donation tracking, AI fraud detection, and digital education. Increased donor trust by 72% and modernized religious education for thousands.

case_study.client: Consortium of Masjids, Madrasas & Islamic Welfare NGOs
case_study.overview: Designed and developed a national-scale Islamic Digital Infrastructure platform that increased donor trust, eliminated charity misuse, modernized madrasa education, and connected millions of users through a secure, transparent ecosystem.

challenge.title: The Problem
challenge.description: Islamic institutions were operating with manual, paper-based systems leading to donation misuse, trust crisis, and operational inefficiencies. Youth were disconnected from masjids, and NGOs failed government audits.
pain_points: No transparency in donation usage - donors had zero proof of where money went
Manual attendance, fees, and record-keeping in Madrasas causing inefficiency
Zakat miscalculation and double distribution to same beneficiaries
Youth completely disconnected from Masjid activities
Islamic misinformation spreading online (fake hadiths, TikTok fatwas)
NGOs failing audits due to poor documentation and record-keeping

solution.title: The Solution
solution.description: Built a comprehensive digital ecosystem with microservices architecture, covering donations, education, zakat distribution, content verification, and mobile engagement.
key_features: Transparent Donation System: Real-time tracking with GPS proof, photos, and public dashboards
Digital Madrasa Management: Automated attendance, fee recovery, parent portals, performance tracking
Smart Zakat Calculator: AI-powered calculator with verified beneficiary system and geo-mapping
Youth Engagement Platform: Gamified Islamic challenges, live dars, mobile notifications, volunteer programs
Scholar Content Verification: AI-powered hadith authentication and fatwa verification engine
Audit & Compliance System: Auto audit-ready reports with immutable transaction logs

frontend: Next.js for web admin & public portal
Flutter for iOS + Android super app
blockchain: Optional immutable ledger for charity records

results.title: The Impact - Pilot Phase
results.description: Within the pilot rollout across select institutions, the platform delivered measurable improvements in transparency, efficiency, and engagement.

metrics.label: Monthly Donations
metrics.description: Increase due to transparency and donor trust

metrics.label: Donor Retention
metrics.description: Donors continue giving when they see proof of impact

metrics.label: Fee Defaulters
metrics.description: Automated reminders and parent portal visibility

metrics.label: Audit Flags
metrics.description: All institutions passed government audits cleanly

metrics.label: Youth Volunteers
metrics.description: Triple increase in youth masjid engagement

testimonial.text: Leading this project taught me the true power of technology in serving society. We didn't just build software - we restored trust in Islamic institutions, modernized religious education, and reconnected youth with their faith. Seeing donors receive photo proof of their charity being used, watching parents track their children's Quran progress in real-time, and knowing we prevented fraud through AI - that's impact beyond code. This project combines my technical skills with meaningful purpose.
testimonial.author: Khateeb Ur Rehman

metrics.label: Response Rate
